FAQ

Common questions

What makes a good lead capture form?

Ask for email first, keep it to 5 questions or fewer, use a conversational one-at-a-time layout, qualify intent with a budget or timeline question, and show a strong CTA on the final screen. FormflowX's template follows all of these principles out of the box.

Can FormflowX save partial submissions?

Yes. On FormflowX Pro, partial submissions are captured automatically — so if someone fills in their email and abandons the form, that data is saved in your dashboard. This is one of the highest-ROI features for lead gen forms.

Can I connect this to my CRM?

Yes. Via Zapier (Pro), you can push leads to HubSpot, Salesforce, Airtable, Notion, Mailchimp, or any CRM with a Zapier integration. You can also use Webhooks (Pro) to push data directly to your own backend. Google Sheets sync is available free.

How many questions should a lead capture form have?

5 or fewer for the best conversion rates. Our template uses 5: email, intent, budget, timeline, and name. You can remove name if you only need an email and use conditional logic to keep less-interested leads on a shorter path.
